subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Class 702 had a special homework assignment: spend no more than $100 in one week and write down…”?
options: Many students laughed because they had phones.
Many students were unhappy at first.
At first, students thought it was a game.
Many students thought it would be easy.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Many students laughed because they had phones.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Many students were unhappy at first.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「At first, students thought it was a game.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Many students thought it would be easy.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Many students thought it would be easy.」，答案為「Many students thought it would be easy.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Many students thought it would be easy.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
